title: organizational-alignment-briefing-sprint-to-q4
body:
Purpose:
This is a working brief to align exec, product, engineering, and GTM leads ahead of the Q4 planning window and the company all-hands (tentative in late April). Use this as the single-source scratch doc for the next two weeks of prep: OKR drafts, topline metrics, friction points we need exec decisions on, and the proposed all-hands run-of-show.

TL;DR (one-paragraph):
We need to converge on three company-level OKRs for Q4 that reflect: 1) predictable production inference (latency & cost SLOs for top-10 customers), 2) commercial adoption for Dedicated and Private (2–3 pilot wins + roadmap for on-prem), and 3) platform usability improvements (Console + SDK adoption signals). Engineering capacity will prioritize Serving Runtime performance, Dedicated autoscaling, and the Platform routing/caching work. Sales will be asked to convert two in-flight pilots into revenue-qualified accounts. Exec decision required on 1) headcount tradeoffs for infra vs. product, and 2) a limited marketing push for Dedicated pilots (budget ask below).

Company-level OKR Drafts (Q4 candidate):
- OKR A: Production Predictability — "Improve inference predictability for paying customers."
  - KR1: Reduce p95 text-generation latency by 20% on our Hosted API for customers with 99th percentile request sizes.
  - KR2: Achieve per-token cost reduction of 15% for steady-state workloads through batching + caching improvements.
  - KR3: 90% of top-10 revenue customers on support plan meet our latency SLOs (tracked via telemetry).

- OKR B: Revenue Motion — "Drive adoption for Dedicated & Private."
  - KR1: Convert 3 Dedicated pilots to paid contracts (>$50k ARR each).
  - KR2: Close 2 Private deployment pilots with Compliance checklists signed.
  - KR3: Publish a partner marketplace listing and run 1 co-sell pilot with channel partner.

- OKR C: Developer Experience & Observability — "Make Redwood the path of least resistance for engineers shipping LLM features."
  - KR1: Increase Console DAU by 35% and SDK activation rate by 25%.
  - KR2: Launch a guided rollout flow (canary + auto-fallback) and get 10 customers to use it.
  - KR3: Reduce mean time to troubleshoot (MTT) for model route incidents by 30% via tracing and runbooks.

Notes on KR definitions: these are intentionally outcome-oriented and intentionally omit implementation details. We will attach team-level KRs in the team planning pass (end of month).

Topline metrics snapshot (latest available):
- MRR (hosted): $1.8M (baseline) — growth target +12% for Q4.
- Dedicated pipeline: 11 active pilots (3 high-probability), ARR pipeline $1.2M.
- Average p95 latency (hosted, all routes): 340ms; target baseline for Q4 planning: 270ms.
- Token unit economics: blended cost/token $0.0009; target reduction KR is through batching+cache.

Engineering prioritization recommendations (short):
1) Serving runtime perf: focus on attention kernel improvements and KV cache stability (2.5 sprint priority).
2) Dedicated autoscaling + burst capacity: needed for pilot SLAs (2 sprints + on-call support).
3) Console rollout UX + tracing hooks: critical for reducing MTT and increasing adoption (1.5 sprints).
4) Private deployment packaging and hardened KMS integration: required for two compliance pilots (parallel security sprint).

Resourcing ask for execs: (for Q4 window)
- Temporary headcount shift: 1 senior infra SWE (3 months) + 0.5 PM FTE to accelerate Dedicated autoscale.
- Budget ask: $75k marketing/co-sell budget to run two joint workshops with partners and a pilot landing page campaign.

All-hands (late April) proposed run-of-show (90 minutes):
- 00:00–00:10 Opening + company health (CEO) — topline metrics + thank-you.
- 00:10–00:25 Engineering highlights (runtime wins & perf roadmap) — short demo of p95 improvements.
- 00:25–00:40 Product/GS updates (Dedicated/Private pilots + Console) — what to expect next quarter.
- 00:40–00:55 Customer story (pre-recorded + live Q&A with successes).
- 00:55–01:10 People & culture (hiring update, org design changes).
- 01:10–01:20 Exec Q&A (live via Slido or Slack thread).
- 01:20–01:30 Closing + 3 company asks + post-event survey link.

Prep checklist (owners):
- Metrics deck (finance): Liam Chen — deliver by 2026-03-22.
- OKR one-pager (cross-functional): Aisha Banerjee + Marisol Ortega — draft by 2026-03-18.
- Customer story producer: Sophie Rutledge — coordinate recording by 2026-03-25.
- Engineering demo readiness: Devon Patel — perf demo runbook + fallbacks by 2026-03-29.
- Slides + speaker notes: comms team — final by 2026-04-05.

Open questions & decision points for execs (require answers by 2026-03-20):
- Q1: Approve temporary hiring shift & $75k marketing budget? (decision owner: CEO/CFO).
- Q2: Prioritization tie-breaker — if we cannot staff both runtime perf and Dedicated autoscale fully, which is higher-impact for revenue this quarter? (decider: CTO + Head of Product).
- Q3: Public comms posture for Private pilot customers — can we list them as references? (legal sign-off needed).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Perf work takes longer than expected and delays Dedicated pilot SLAs.
  - Mitigation: staged rollout with conservative canary and explicit fallback policy; sales notified template.
- Risk: Console changes introduce regressions that affect user workflows.
  - Mitigation: gated rollouts, telemetry checks, and a 48-hour rollback window.
- Risk: Hiring constraints slow down delivery.
  - Mitigation: leverage contractors for short-term burst and reprioritize non-critical work.

Communication plan (pre-all-hands):
- Week 0 (now): circulate this briefing + ask for edits (owners above).
- Week 2: draft company OKRs posted to Confluence (feedback window 3 business days).
- Week 4: rehearsal and dry-run with speakers.
- All-hands: post event — publish recording + top-three follow-up asks + short survey.

Appendix: Notes-to-self / rough brainstorm fragments (keep in Drive):
- "Consider an incentives pilot: credits for customers who switch Dedicated from trial to paid in 60 days"
- "Try smaller, more frequent engineering milestones vs. 1 big perf push — measure weekly"
- "Slack thread: #dedicated-pilots has a log of infra blockers — link: slack://channel?id=dedicated-pilots"

Action items (immediate):
- Aisha: synthesize and send exec summary + highlighted decisions by 2026-03-12.
- Marisol: start customer reference checklist and coordinate legal review by 2026-03-16.
- Devon: prototype perf dashboard focused on p95 + per-route cost; first draft 2026-03-17.

If you are reading this and want edit access: please annotate directly in this doc and add reactions for any major objections. This remains intentionally rough — we will lock the OKRs after the exec review on 2026-03-20.

Document history (notes):
- 2026-02-10: initial outline and OKR seed (Aisha).
- 2026-02-22: added pilot conversion metrics (Liam).
- 2026-03-01: integrated engineering prioritization notes (Devon).
- 2026-03-05: consolidated feedback from GTM leads (Marisol) — current draft.

---
End of brief."
